target.statement: Mean LOCO ROC-AUC of 0.704 for Sim2Win (CatBoost) across seven held-out competitions
target.dataset: StatsBomb open event data (11 competitions, 1,411 team-match rows)

compute.basis: Requires downloading StatsBomb open data, rebuilding the event-to-feature pipeline (rolling 5-match profiles, ratios, K-Means, 13 models) and running 7 LOCO folds of CatBoost/XGBoost on ~1.4k rows; all CPU-friendly but pipeline reconstruction from partial code is the main cost.

blockers: Code repo may not fully reproduce the exact LOCO pipeline/feature engineering
Gemini-generated narratives and TabPFN components not needed for target but add setup friction
Exact LOCO fold definitions and preprocessing details must be re-derived from text
title: Sim2Win: A Team-Agnostic, Event-Based Pre-Match Outcome Prediction and Tactical Profiling System for Football
